tr.td: Breathlessness on exertion and a dry cough for three months, worse on tour, with tiredness and chest tightness; she can no longer hold long phrases; bilateral hilar lymph node enlargement on today's chest radiograph; granulomas were reported at an abdominal operation twelve years ago, with no pathology report available: sarcoidosis must be confirmed by tissue and other causes excluded
S — Synthetic presenting problem anchored to the documented breathlessness during performances and the 1952 granulomas. Superseded by the tissue diagnosis at the consultation.

Palpitations with two spells of light-headedness while singing; ECG today: sinus rhythm with first-degree atrioventricular block (PR 240 ms) and frequent ventricular ectopic beats: cardiac involvement must be looked for
S — Synthetic finding; superseded when cardiac sarcoidosis was diagnosed.
Hypercalcemia: calcium 10.8 mg/dL with a high 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D and a low 25-hydroxyvitamin D, while taking an over-the-counter calcium and vitamin D supplement; creatinine slightly raised
S — Synthetic finding; resolved on treatment.

list.item: Breathlessness on exertion and a dry cough for three months, worse on tour, with tiredness and chest tightness; she can no longer hold long phrases; bilateral hilar lymph node enlargement on today's chest radiograph; granulomas were reported at an abdominal operation twelve years ago, with no pathology report available: sarcoidosis must be confirmed by tissue and other causes excluded: active, confirmed [S]

Palpitations with two spells of light-headedness while singing; ECG today: sinus rhythm with first-degree atrioventricular block (PR 240 ms) and frequent ventricular ectopic beats: cardiac involvement must be looked for: active, confirmed [S]

Hypercalcemia: calcium 10.8 mg/dL with a high 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D and a low 25-hydroxyvitamin D, while taking an over-the-counter calcium and vitamin D supplement; creatinine slightly raised: active, confirmed [S]

Pulmonology (sarcoidosis) consultation within two weeks, with EBUS-guided lymph node sampling arranged directly from the referral, to confirm the diagnosis and plan treatment. Guideline: Crouser ED, et al. Diagnosis and Detection of Sarcoidosis. An Official American Thoracic Society Clinical Practice Guideline. Am J Respir Crit Care Med 2020;201(8):e26-e51 (PMID 32293205) (2020); Baughman RP, et al. ERS clinical practice guidelines on treatment of sarcoidosis. Eur Respir J 2021;58(6):2004079 (PMID 34140301) (2021) [S]

Diagnosis of suspected sarcoidosis: chest radiograph and CT of the chest, tissue by EBUS-guided needle aspiration rather than mediastinoscopy, stains and cultures for mycobacteria and fungi, an interferon-gamma release assay and HIV test to exclude other causes; serum ACE is not used to make or exclude the diagnosis. Guideline: Crouser ED, et al. Diagnosis and Detection of Sarcoidosis. An Official American Thoracic Society Clinical Practice Guideline. Am J Respir Crit Care Med 2020;201(8):e26-e51 (PMID 32293205) (2020) [S]

Screening every patient with suspected sarcoidosis for other organ involvement: ECG, serum calcium with 25-hydroxyvitamin D and 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D, creatinine, liver tests and alkaline phosphatase, complete blood count, TSH, and an eye examination; stop the calcium and vitamin D supplement while calcium is high. Guideline: Crouser ED, et al. Diagnosis and Detection of Sarcoidosis. An Official American Thoracic Society Clinical Practice Guideline. Am J Respir Crit Care Med 2020;201(8):e26-e51 (PMID 32293205) (2020) [S]

Depression screening at each phase, plain explanations with written information, and support she chooses; she decides who receives each note. Guideline: Depression and Suicide Risk in Adults: Screening (2023) [S]
